description:
About the Scholarship

SuCat is the Erasmus Mundus master in sustainable catalysis delivered by a consortium including Rovira i Virgili University in Tarragona, now opening its application portal on 23 October 2026 for the 2027-2029 intake. The last round closed on 19 February (23:59 Brussels time), a date the 2027 round is expected to mirror.

OpportunitySuCat – Erasmus Mundus Master in Sustainable Catalysis
HostSuCat Consortium
LocationTarragona (multi-country mobility), Spain
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
Stipend€1,400/month
Application Deadline19 February 2027
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

SuCat is the Erasmus Mundus master in sustainable catalysis delivered by a consortium including Rovira i Virgili University in Tarragona, now opening its application portal on 23 October 2026 for the 2027-2029 intake. The last round closed on 19 February (23:59 Brussels time), a date the 2027 round is expected to mirror.

Programme Highlights

  • Specialised catalysis training with green-chemistry and industry relevance
  • Portal for the 2027-2029 intake opens 23 October 2026
  • Scholarship round historically closes on 19 February (23:59 Brussels time)
  • 30 places per edition with laboratory-heavy, research-driven training

Who Should Apply

Chemistry, chemical engineering and biochemistry graduates with strong organic and physical chemistry fundamentals are the natural applicants.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students: tuition coverage plus a monthly allowance (around EUR 1,400).

Deadline and How to Apply

Create your application on the SuCat site after 23 October 2026 and target the February scholarship deadline with reference letters ready early. Key deadline information: 19 February 2027 (23:59 Brussels time, expected); application portal opens 23 October 2026.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About SuCat Consortium

The SuCat consortium delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Sustainable Catalysis with a consortium led from Rovira i Virgili University and European partner institutions specialised in homogeneous and heterogeneous catalysis.

Official website: https://www.master-sucat.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 19 February 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

  • University Motivation Letter: Explain Your Preparation and Course Choice
  • A 12-Month Study Abroad Application Plan for Master's and PhD Applicants
